prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details for INV-71675
prose.body:
Hi Jonah,

Hope you’re having a good week. I’m reaching out directly as we’ve just finalized our internal migration to a new treasury platform. This is a quick administrative update regarding the pending payment for invoice INV-71675.

Our previous payout account has been retired as of this morning. To ensure the 7,562.50 USDC settles correctly without triggering manual review delays on our end, please direct the transfer to our new dedicated billing account:

quillonmedia14-billing.testnet

The amount and memo details remain exactly the same as previously discussed. Could you please confirm if this transfer can be scheduled for today? Our finance team is monitoring the ledger and needs the funds to clear before the end of the day to close out our current sprint cycle. 

I know this is short notice, but I appreciate your flexibility. If you have any questions or need a quick confirmation from our CFO, I can loop him in immediately.

Thanks,
Tomas Brennan
Senior Finance Manager
Quillon Media
